8GB-VISION-MAX-Q8-100K.label: 🏆 Default: 110k ctx + q8_0 KV + Vision (CPU proyector) + Thinking
8GB-VISION-MAX-Q8-100K.description: DEFAULT: 110,592 tokens con KV q8_0 (casi sin perdida) + vision + 4096 de pensamiento. El proyector de vision vive en RAM (-mmprojCPU), lo que libera ~879 MiB y permite 110k en vez de 71k; cada imagen se codifica en CPU. Medido: 7,830 MiB, retrieval real PASS.

8GB-VISION-MAX-Q8.label: ⚡ 71k ctx + q8_0 KV + Vision en GPU + Thinking (vision rapida)
8GB-VISION-MAX-Q8.description: 71,680 tokens, q8_0 KV (near-lossless) + vision en GPU + 4096-thinking. Measured 7,543 MiB; deep retrieval at 56,306 real tokens PASS. 73,728 OOMs.

8GB-VISION-MAX-Q4.label: 🗺️ Max context: 110k ctx + q4_0 KV + Vision + Thinking
8GB-VISION-MAX-Q4.description: MAX CONTEXT: 110,592 tokens, q4_0 KV + vision + thinking. Measured 7,497 MiB; deep retrieval at 87,433 real tokens PASS. 114,688 OOMs. Use when you need the largest window.

8GB-VISION-MAX-F16.label: 🏆 MAX precision: 43k ctx + f16 KV + Vision + Thinking
8GB-VISION-MAX-F16.description: MAX PRECISION: 43,008 tokens with full f16 KV + vision + thinking. Measured 7,481 MiB; deep retrieval at 33,373 real tokens PASS. 45k OOMs.

8GB-VISION-DEFAULT-F16.label: ✅ Default: 16k ctx + f16 KV + Vision (ROCK SOLID)
8GB-VISION-DEFAULT-F16.description: SAFE: 16,384 tokens with full f16 KV cache + vision. Rock-solid with lots of VRAM headroom. Use when other GPU apps are running.

8GB-VISION-ULTRA-F16.label: 🔥 Ultra F16: 32k ctx + f16 KV + Vision (MAX PRECISION)
8GB-VISION-ULTRA-F16.description: MAX PRECISION: 32,768 tokens with full f16 KV cache + vision. Note: may crash on idle due to llama.cpp bug. Use for high-quality single requests.

8GB-VISION-ULTRA.label: ⚡ Ultra: 36k ctx + q4_0 KV + Vision
8GB-VISION-ULTRA.description: Maximum vision context at low KV cost. q4_0 KV fits 36k + vision; speculative decoding only if the draft model is present.

8GB-VISION-HIGH.label: 🚀 High: 32k ctx + q8_0 KV + Vision
8GB-VISION-HIGH.description: Best balance for coding with vision. q8_0 KV is near-lossless (8/8 in the KV quality test) and fits 32k + vision.

8GB-VISION-BALANCED.label: ⚖️ Balanced: 28k ctx + q4_0 KV + Vision
8GB-VISION-BALANCED.description: Safe choice for vision workloads. q4_0 KV is stable and saves ~600MB vs f16.

8GB-VISION-SAFE.label: 🛡️ Safe: 24k ctx + q4_0 KV + Vision
8GB-VISION-SAFE.description: Conservative with large margin. For heavy vision + long context tasks.

8GB-CODE-MAX.label: 💻 Code Max: 48k ctx + q4_0 KV (no vision)
8GB-CODE-MAX.description: Maximum code-only context. q4_0 KV fits 48k without vision. SpecDecode only if the draft model is present.

8GB-CODE-HIGH.label: 💻 Code High: 40k ctx + q4_0 KV (no vision)
8GB-CODE-HIGH.description: High context coding without vision. q4_0 KV stable, saves ~600MB.

8GB-CODE-BALANCED.label: 💻 Code Balanced: 32k ctx + q8_0 KV (no vision)
8GB-CODE-BALANCED.description: Sweet spot for code tasks. q8_0 KV near-lossless, saves ~300MB vs f16.

8GB-CODE-FAST.label: ⚡ Code Fast: 16k ctx + f16 KV + SpecDecode
8GB-CODE-FAST.description: Maximum throughput for short-context coding. Large batch + SpecDecode = ~3x token speed.

8GB-RESEARCH.label: 🔬 Research: 64k ctx + q4_0 KV (no vision, experimental)
8GB-RESEARCH.description: EXPERIMENTAL: 64k text-only context. q4_0 KV keeps it in VRAM; quality per token is lower than q8_0/f16 at long range.

8GB-VISION-QUALITY.label: 🎨 Vision Quality: 32k ctx + f16 KV + Vision (best quality)
8GB-VISION-QUALITY.description: Best vision quality. f16 KV preserves full precision. Tight margin - monitor VRAM.
